WHY THIS IS A REAL MULTI-AGENT GAME

Conversation changes
what each agent can know.

The models do not receive the same prompt. Each starts with evidence the other cannot see, so useful dialogue—not parallel answers—is the only path to the rescue channel.

01

Private evidence

One agent gets physical telemetry. The other gets the channel registry. Neither can solve the case alone.

02

Shared memory

Every exchange returns to both models, while your directive changes what they examine next.

03

Deterministic verdict

The incident data fixes the right channel. Code checks your choice, so no AI grades its own story.
